How does this occupation differ from middle school teachers and special education teachers?

This occupation serves the primary school stage and focuses on basic subjects, study habits, and social-emotional development; middle and high school teachers serve higher grade levels with deeper subject differentiation; special education teachers serve students with special needs and require individualized education plans; preschool teachers serve the pre-school stage; instructional coordinators provide curriculum and teaching support and do not lead a class directly.

Work context

Primary school teachers work in public or private primary schools, completing lesson preparation, teaching, homework grading, and learning assessment around one class, are at school while students are in class, and prepare lessons in the evening and on weekends.
Work locations: mainly school classrooms and office spaces, with coordination needed at activity venues and off-campus practice sites.
Main objects: primary school students, basic subject courses and class affairs, and communication with parents and the school.
Requires handover with teaching research groups, grade groups, school management, and parents.

How AI will change the work of primary school teachers

AI and digital tools can assist with retrieving lesson preparation materials, drafting assignments and tests, organizing grade and attendance data, and drafting home-school notices; they cannot replace classroom teaching and teaching to individual needs, judgments about student learning and behavior, class management, communication with parents, or responsibility involving student records and safety, nor do they carry the professional conclusions of teacher qualification and student assessment. paragraphs: Education, discipline, teacher qualification, and teaching scope requirements in a job posting must be read item by item; one relaxable item does not mean other conditions can be substituted.

title.text: Primary school teachers: duties, pay, and entry paths

subject.name: Primary school teachers
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 25-2021.00, this occupation teaches basic subjects to primary school students: it designs courses and lessons, teaches and tutors, assesses learning progress, manages the class, communicates with parents, and takes part in teaching research and professional development, with responsibility for student learning and on-campus safety.
